claim: An opt-in causal-context readout that derives state only from previous witnessed action/consequence events, learns small numeric temporal readout parameters from post-reveal predictive error, and retains the sole existing cumulative native model exactly, can be constructed and replayed without reading source-hidden domains, reward oracle, protected worlds, or modifying RET01 original frozen science.

model.base: unchanged existing ArchivedEvidenceReadout with original native seven-component continuation
model.features: bias, four current public view bits, two public intervention bits, two most recently witnessed action/state/reward quadruplets, and archive/live forecast disagreement in first and second public outcomes; no current outcome/truth, no evaluator phase, source identity, epoch, seed, or private state
model.output: read-only temporal mixture forecast; no change to original native intervention policy; original archive/live and frozen gate remain retrievable
model.training: after validated native witness admission only, one deterministic bounded Brier gradient step against the revealed public consequences, with source-id de-duplication and exact checkpoint cold replay; reward targets not read by forecast feature builder

mechanical: two prior witnessed events affect temporal features after source admission
new original native and archived checkpoints preserved
duplicate idempotence, conflicting event fails atomically
cold snapshot byte-identical with independent replay from old source
ablation zeroes prior history features without leaking current row

prospective_science_if_owner_admitted.require: new separately authenticated unfamiliar action consequence source; source-owner signed cohort and actor lease before first action
prospective_science_if_owner_admitted.metrics: prequential 2-outcome Brier; >=0.005 improvement against strongest of equally fitted history-aware Beta, bounded RNN, and symbolic causal learner on EACH replica; no old readout regression >0.005; cold retention, causal action/phase ablations and whole-process runtime/memory/bytes
prospective_science_if_owner_admitted.split: disjoint original TRAIN/VALID/HELD/TRANSFER; FIT-only hyperparameters; never reuse scored RET01 cohort
prospective_science_if_owner_admitted.stop: one prespecified development screen, <=2 FIT-only revisions only if signal, no HELD retuning
